title: Inconclusive performance anomaly
fix_rationale: No profiled timer exceeded baseline thresholds sufficiently to establish a root cause. The hitch may be caused by uninstrumented native code, OS scheduling preemption, page faults, or hardware throttling.
evidence_template: No profiled timer exceeded baseline thresholds sufficiently to establish a root cause.

fixes.text: Re-capture the trace with full engine channels enabled (-trace=cpu,gpu,frame,loadtime -cpuprofilertrace).
Inspect the thread timeline in Unreal Insights to visually locate uninstrumented timing gaps.

verify: Re-capture with cpuprofilertrace to provide fine-grained timing data.
caveats: Insufficient profiled timer excess to confidently identify a specific engine bottleneck.
